# sorobeacon_channel (Resource)

Manages a SoroBeacon notification channel.

**WARNING: channel config contains secrets** (webhook URLs, bot tokens, SMTP credentials). Terraform stores attribute values in plain text in state. Always encrypt your state backend (e.g. S3+KMS). The config attribute is marked Sensitive so `terraform plan` redacts it, but the state file itself is NOT encrypted by Terraform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Channel-specific config as a JSON string. Contains secrets — see the warning above.
- `name` (String) Channel display name.
- `type` (String) Channel type (slack, discord, telegram, email, webhook, matrix, pagerduty, federation).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
